products.title: Royal Canin Breed Health Nutrition French Bulldog Adult Dry Dog Food
products.description: Delight your French Bulldog every time you open a bag of Royal Canin Breed Health Nutrition French Bulldog Puppy Dry Dog Food. This recipe features a customized curved-shaped kibble that is specially designed for your French Bulldog’s short muzzle and jaw shape, making this food easy for your little dog to pick up and chew. Not only that, but this complete and balanced puppy food provides the nutrition to help your best friend thrive. An exclusive mix of antioxidants and vitamin E promotes healthy development of your puppy’s immune system, while exclusive nutrients help support the skin barrier for healthy skin. This food is formulated with high-quality protein and prebiotics to support digestive health and a balanced intestinal flora, contributing to optimal stool quality. Serve your furbaby this tasty food and promote your puppy’s overall wellness with every meal.

variants.title: Royal Canin Breed Health Nutrition French Bulldog Adult Dry Dog Food, 6-lb bag
variants.description: Give your furbaby tasty nutrition tailored just for them with Royal Canin Breed Health Nutrition French Bulldog Adult Dry Dog Food. This food features a customized curved-shaped kibble specially designed for your French bulldog’s short muzzle and jaw shape, making it easy for them to pick up and chew. This complete and balanced recipe provides the nutrition needed to help your best friend thrive. Protein and L-carnitine help support healthy muscles, while exclusive nutrients help support the skin barrier for healthy skin. A combination of highly digestible proteins, precise fiber content, and high-quality carbohydrate sources helps to support your Frenchie’s healthy digestion and decrease flatulence and unpleasant stool odors. Serve up this delicious food and promote your pup’s overall wellness with every meal.
